notes: The chronogram pañca(5)-agni(3)-vasu(8)-indu(1), read right to left, gives 1835. The colophon does not name the era. VS (= 1778 CE) comes from the catalogue and is plausible for a copy made on the Gomatī. If the era were ŚS, the date would be 1913 CE. The weekday has not been checked. 'vācaspatīśirama' is a corruption of Vācaspatimiśra, the father of the commentator Lakṣmīdāsa. 'sāṃghrir' after 'vāre sūryasya' is unclear: it may be a corruption, perhaps 'sāṃdhri'/'saṃdhyā'. I have not treated it as a name. 'jñātau śrīpārvatī yaḥ' = 'jñātau śrīpārvatīyaḥ' (of the Pārvatīya community). The scribe's unnamed son is a beneficiary. 'putakam idaṃ śrīkṛṣṇajośī rāmanagaravāle' (= pustakam) is an ownership note, probably later and in Hindi ('vāle'). The catalogue lists Kṛṣṇa Jośī as 'Donor', but the colophon only shows ownership.
